I answered Pree in a thread on her message in #central-team. The store was Pine Crossing.

She raised it in that channel herself on Jun 9. The morning receiver had said the appointment screen only showed the afternoon shift, and a driver who arrived at 7:10 had his trailer number written on a sticky note. Hollis said he'd check the shift template.

I couldn't find an address or location for Pine Crossing in anything she can see, and no account files are visible in the share. I told her that and suggested she check the store address sheet before filling in the site.

One thing I didn't tell her: the onboarding ticket for the six new stores (SUP-5102) in the knowledge brain names a "Mill Crossing", not a Pine Crossing. That ticket isn't in the files she can see, so I left it out. The two names may get mixed up when she updates the sheet.
